specs: lug to lug in the photo
end link in the photo (20 listed)
notes: Modelled: rose gold bezel with a 120-notch coin edge, black insert with the rose gold triangle, numerals and minute bars as traced inlays, polished inner lip, applied indices with rose gold frames and lume (round dots, triangle at 12, bars at 3 and 9), rose gold baton hands with lume, rose gold seconds hand with a lume dot and a cross-bar counterweight, fluted steel crown between crown guards, brushed lugs, three-column bracelet with steel outer and rose gold centre links.
From the photo map: black sunray dial, TISSOT 1853, SEASTAR, 30 bar (300m / 1000 ft), SWISS MADE, the date window (30) and the rehaut minute track.
Under the hands the dial is a smooth fill; it is covered by the 3D hands. The rehaut's reflections of the indices are replaced by plain minute track.
Scale is the listed 40 mm case; heights come from Tissot's side view scaled to the listed 9.97 mm.
